BackstoryDef.title: blood servant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came to the Cult with nothing and gave it the only thing [PAWN_pronoun] had: a bowl of [PAWN_possessive] own blood every new moon. Servants who keep giving become disciples; the others become lanterns.

BackstoryDef.title: rift runner
BackstoryDef.description: When the rifts to Jiuxiao opened, the Cult sent its expendables through first. [PAWN_nameDef] went in three times and came back three times, carrying maps drawn in [PAWN_possessive] own blood because ink froze on the other side.

BackstoryDef.title: blood disciple
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a full disciple of the Blood Moon, taught to draw qi from the blood of the fallen instead of from the sky. The orthodox sects call it theft; the Cult calls it not letting anything go to waste.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of soul lanterns
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the soul lanterns of Shi Gu, the elder of souls: one flame for each disciple of the Cult, which flickers when its owner is hurt and goes out when they die. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read a battle from a room full of candles.

BackstoryDef.title: crimson envoy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried the Blood Saint's word to sects that would rather have killed the messenger. Su Lanyin chooses envoys who smile easily and bleed slowly; [PAWN_nameDef] has done both in front of three sect masters.

BackstoryDef.title: collector of blood debts
BackstoryDef.description: Every blood debt owed to the Cult is written in a red book, and [PAWN_nameDef] carried it for years. Debtors pay in blood, in service or in kind; [PAWN_pronoun] never cared which, only that the line was crossed out.

BackstoryDef.title: blood elder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was among the first disciples of Xue Jiuyou, the Venerable, and was there when the Heavenly Origin sect purged them. [PAWN_pronoun] has outlived most of the elders who did it, and visits the graves of the rest.

BackstoryDef.title: elder of souls
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied under Shi Gu, who believes the soul is just blood that has learned to think. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks softly, never raises a hand in anger, and nobody in the Cult has ever won an argument against [PAWN_objective].
